additional_info.subject: FW: RE: 0455007 - ID0455007-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002646] Charging Issue CRM:03055000088
additional_info.body:
Dear RC-IT,
This charger has an issue on the AC charging.
After checking the logs, it was identified that the AC contactor did not close.
Please check the following circuit:
The issue is most likely related with the contactor Q8 or the relay KF13.
Follow the 24V from the KF13 that activates Q8
If you have spares just to test, you can also replace QA8 and KF13 (one at a time) and test.
I will send this ticket to your queue for the work onsite.
If you have any questions please do not hesitate ask me or send the ticket back to my queue.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Laura Martins,
Please do not change the subject of this email when replying to it.

additional_info.body:
Hello Giovanni,
You left this ticket in the wrong queue, when you want address this issue again, please send it to the eMobility Inbound queue.
What was performed on-site to resolve the QA8 problem? If there was no action, the problem might return as soon as an AC session is performed.
For the main fan error, remove and plug in the XD7.1B which is above the EcoGs and turn on again FC20.
If after this the error persists, then we need to replace the fan.
I will send this back to the RC-IT queue.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
